headline: Democratic Republic of Congo Plans Two New Gold Refineries
summary: Following its first gold refinery, the Democratic Republic of Congo announced plans to build two additional facilities with a combined 68-ton refining capacity.
why: Expanding local mineral refining capacity allows resource-rich nations to capture higher value-added revenues from precious metal exports.

impacts.name: Democratic Republic of Congo
impacts.why: New refining infrastructure increases local mineral processing capabilities and export values.
